composition.currentLayout: SavedEventsScreen owns uid/provider orchestration, CatchRouteScaffold chrome, club-name lookup, retry invalidation, and event-detail navigation, then resolves SavedEventsListState before passing typed data into provider-free SavedEventsAgendaList, SavedEventsLoading, SavedEventsError, SavedEventsOrganizerNamesErrorState, and SavedEventsMessage sections.
composition.targetLayout: Saved Events should keep providers at the route boundary, one compact route title in CatchRouteScaffold, SavedEventsListState as the ordered-row adapter, and public section widgets as the owner of agenda, loading/error, lookup-error, and empty surfaces.
